The card thread's report `6574284916` names two files outside the claim's surface on PR #29097. The seat accepts both:

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: the connect door's HTTP mount passed `undefined` as the body for all three verbs, so an installer client sent over HTTP never reached the door. The new dogfood case found it on its first run. The fix is POST through `deferRequestBody`; it is the same defect's last hop, so it rides this PR.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` (the connect door's closed body set) and `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` (teaches `clientSource: 'installer'` and the connect body) are the door and its product page.
- Overlap read this act: open PRs #29227 and #29193 edit `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` in disjoint hunks (flow start and flow clone); none touches `dispatcher-plugin.ts` at this hunk or `connectors.mdx`. Whichever lands second merges main.

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` is unchanged; the contract review runs on head `59630d94`.
